name: presenter-not-venue
rule: When the act publishes no email, its own contact form outranks any venue inbox (waterfall step 3). A genuine presenting org is an additive presenter contact; the host venue is never a contact.

sources.label: Grand Theatre listing (the host venue)
sources.content: Downtown Presents brings Lumen Dance to the Grand Theatre, March 12, 2026. Grand Theatre box office: boxoffice@grandtheatre.example.

sources.label: Lumen Dance own site
sources.content: Lumen Dance. We do not publish an email; please reach us through our contact form at https://lumendance.example/contact.

sources.label: Downtown Presents (the presenting org)
sources.content: Downtown Presents produces contemporary dance across the city. General enquiries: hello@presentingorg.example.

expected.description: Surface the act's form and the presenting org; never the Grand Theatre box office or its domain.

draft.subject: Photographing Lumen Dance's March 12 performance at the Grand Theatre
draft.body: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to your March 12 performance at the Grand Theatre. I work in an unobtrusive documentary style, no flash and no interruption, so the audience stays with the performance rather than noticing a photographer. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. I think that coverage would suit this night, and if you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk through your photography plans for the performance. I look forward to hearing from you.
